card.name: Linking words before serotonin-syndrome symptom lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation right before a list of symptoms, mostly in warnings about serotonin syndrome, neuroleptic malignant syndrome or MAOI crises. Examples are 'characterized by', 'include', 'e.g.,' and commas inside the list.

modes.label: Lead-in to symptom list
modes.description: A verb or preposition that introduces the symptoms of a syndrome or crisis.
modes.example: These crises are characterized<< by>> some or all of the following symptoms:

modes.label: Punctuation inside symptom list
modes.description: A comma or 'e.g.,' between listed signs such as autonomic instability or tachycardia.

modes.label: Other warning-section connectors
modes.description: Linking words in contraindication or reaction text, such as 'an' after 'History of'.
modes.example: ( 4 ) History of<< an>> idiosyncratic reaction to prom

card.plain: It fires on the small words that introduce the list of signs in warnings about drug-induced syndromes like NMS or serotonin syndrome.
